subject: Order hasn't arrived — been 3 weeks!
body: I placed order #[ID] on the 1st of May. It is now the 22nd and nothing has arrived. I have a birthday event this weekend and I desperately need the item.
notes: Explicit time pressure (event this weekend) + long delay = high

subject: URGENT — delivery critical for tomorrow
body: I need my order delivered by tomorrow morning for a medical appointment. Please escalate immediately.
notes: Medical context + explicit urgency marker + hard deadline

subject: Order missing for 2 weeks, leaving for holiday Friday
body: My order was placed 14 days ago and still hasn't arrived. I'm leaving the country on Friday and won't be home to receive it.

subject: Still waiting after promised delivery date passed
body: You told me it would arrive by the 10th. It is now the 15th. I need this resolved today.

subject: Wrong item sent — event tonight
body: I ordered a suit for a wedding tonight and received completely the wrong item. This is a disaster.

subject: Wrong item received, no rush
body: I ordered a blue mug but received a red one. Not urgent but I would like to exchange it at some point.
notes: Wrong item but customer explicitly says not urgent

subject: Package arrived damaged
body: My parcel arrived this morning with a cracked lid. The product inside seems okay but the packaging is broken.
notes: Defect but no time pressure, product functional

subject: Order delayed — no update from courier
body: My order was supposed to arrive 3 days ago. The tracking hasn't updated since Tuesday. Can you chase this up?

subject: Part of my order is missing
body: I ordered 3 items but only 2 arrived. The missing item is order line #[ID]. Please advise.
notes: Partial fulfilment, no time pressure stated

subject: Charged twice for one order
body: I can see two charges on my bank statement for order #[ID]. Can you refund the duplicate?
notes: Financial error, requires action but not time-critical

subject: General question about returns policy
body: How many days do I have to return an item if I change my mind? And do I need the original packaging?
notes: Policy question, no purchase or problem mentioned

subject: How do I track my order?
body: I placed an order yesterday. How can I see where it is?
notes: Information request, order presumably on schedule

subject: Can I change my delivery address?
body: I placed an order this morning. Is it too late to change the delivery address to my work address?
notes: Change request, order recent, no urgency signals

subject: Feedback on my recent order
body: I just wanted to say that my recent order arrived quickly and the packaging was lovely. Really happy with the service.

subject: Question about product availability
body: I noticed the blue version of the mug is out of stock. Do you know when it will be back?
notes: Stock enquiry, no purchase yet, no urgency
